title: Topic 19
japanese_text: 実家に帰ると、急に両親に<u>縁談</u>があると言われた。相手の<u>プロフィール</u>はあまり魅力的ではなかったが、せっかくなので会ってみることにした。すると、<u>案の定</u>相手は過去の<u>栄光</u>ばかり語る人で、<u>第一</u>印象は最悪だった。なぜ両親はもっと<u>まともな</u>人との縁談を用意してくれなかったのだろうか。
english_translation: After I got home, my parents suddenly told me someone wanted to discuss marriage with me. His profile wasn't particularly attractive, but I decided to meet him anyway. Sure enough, he was a man who talked only about his past glories, and he made a terrible first impression. Why couldn't my parents find someone more decent?
